_about: Stage 7 (Hangar), SECOND PASS (Barrier route). Segment length as a function of the global frame counter $1A on the stage's first playable frame. Every row is one full solve by contra/stages/s7.py from a debug start state, replayed open-loop twice (identical, no death, weapon $13 out) and checked with check_inputs.py. real_start = no leading pause (title-screen delay state ph<d>, the end state of a stage 6 solve, or the integrator's real run state real_c1_s7_pre); otherwise the phase was set by a pause of lead_pause frames on row 40 (not counted in frames; checked: ph80 + 10 reproduces ph90's marks to within one frame). 'table' = solves with the FINAL code. Made by tools/s7_phase_table.py from tools/s7_phase_scan.py / s7_j_solve1.py runs.

solves_with_earlier_code_versions_of_the.note: asked for fc 168 by a 6-frame pause on row 0, which the game ignored: this is the plain start fc 162

pairing_with_stage_6.rule: stage 7's $1A on its first frame = stage 6's $1A on its first frame + stage 6's segment length - the lag frames inside stage 6's segment (mod 256; 13 of them are in the load, 14-22 measured in total: 15 is used below). With the Barrier route stage 7 should depend on $1A mod 128 only; the measured 128-apart pairs (period_check) differ by 10-31 frames through random soldiers (claw corridor plan, lag), so read every stage 7 number as +-15.
pairing_with_stage_6.caveat: predicted = stage 6 table (cluster scan + measured prefix/suffix, first builder) + stage 7 at the NEAREST scanned phase (the scan step is 8; stage 7 changes by tens of frames between neighbouring phases, so a predicted pair is good to about +/-20 frames). Only measured_chains are real: stage 7 solved from the state a stage 6 segment ends in.

what_depends_on_the_phase.global_timer_claws: x 310..438 (screen 1, lower route), 742/758, 1270..1398 (the corridor before the cart: 0 to 15 frames), 3014..3094 (six long claws: 5 to 10 frames): drop when $1A & $7F == trigger; a 5-frame pause over the trigger frame deletes the drop
what_depends_on_the_phase.seeking_claws_heartbreak_alley: no longer matter: Bill is invincible there (Barrier)
what_depends_on_the_phase.random: soldiers and their bullets (the random number is advanced by the idle loop): one solve lost 33 frames to a jump into a hanging wall before the remedy cost check was added
